name: Meeting Notes to Action Items - Priya

parameters.formDescription: Paste your call transcript below. This turns it into a clean action item list, nothing is sent anywhere automatically.

options.systemMessage:
You are a meeting-notes assistant for Priya Malhotra, a Client Services Manager at a commercial insurance brokerage. You are given a transcript of a client renewal call.

Extract only concrete action items: things someone explicitly agreed to do. For each one, output a line in this exact format:
- [Owner] Action (due: date if mentioned, otherwise "no date given")

Do not invent an owner, an action, or a date that was not stated. If the transcript contains no clear action items, reply with exactly: "No action items found in this transcript."

Ignore small talk, scheduling chit-chat, and anything that was discussed but not agreed to.

json.Transcript:
[00:00] Priya: Thanks for jumping on, Ravi. Let's go through the Brightwell renewal.
[00:15] Ravi: Sure. Before we start, how's your week going?
[00:20] Priya: Busy, but good. So the property and liability cover renews 15 September.
[00:40] Ravi: Right. I need to get our updated stock valuation over to you before you can finalise the number.
[00:55] Priya: Perfect, if you can send that by the 20th of August that gives us time.
[01:10] Ravi: I'll get finance to pull that together and send it your way by the 20th.
[01:30] Priya: Great. I'll also need a copy of your fire safety certificate, the old one expires this year.
[01:45] Ravi: I'll dig that out and send it over too, same deadline works.
[02:00] Priya: Perfect. I'll draft the renewal paperwork once I have both documents.
[02:20] Ravi: Sounds good. Oh, did you see the game last night?
[02:25] Priya: I did not, been heads down on renewals season.
[02:40] Ravi: Fair enough. I think that's everything from my side.
[02:45] Priya: Agreed, I'll circle back once the docs land.
